text:
alex: heads up — deploybot flagged a missing deadman heartbeat for the post-deploy synthetic in eu1 after the 06:00 rollout. deploybot says 3/5 probes failed for the prefill-synth. not alerting prod yet but wanted eyes.

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth-monitor eu1: missing_deadman_heartbeat (3/5 fails). canary cohort: 10%. rolling forward paused. logs: /deploy/logs/1762468000/eu1.

maya: copying logs now. any obvious 502s or timeouts?

sre-bot: quick summary from sampler: p95 latency jumped from 48ms -> 420ms for prefill probe, tokenization step shows 1.2s spikes on a minority of hosts. correlation: a single host group had KV warmup thrash.

sam: thanks. can we run the same probe against the previous pinned model (model-v2.3) to rule out model variant regressions?

sylvia: also check routing — could be a region routing flapping to eu2 fallback nodes. maya, can you run a manual curl against the synth endpoint and paste response headers?

maya: doing that now — output below:
```
$ curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://synth-internal.eu1.redwood/api/prefill-check
HTTP/2 200
server: r-inference/1.2
x-probe-latency-ms: 512
content-length: 0
```

maya: latency header consistent with the bot. 512ms on this run. payloads are tiny so this smells like a warmup/KV cache miss wave.

sam: if it's warmup, fallback to previous model won't help. we should try cross-checking by forcing a node-level prefill (restart agent) for the flagged instance group and re-run the probe.

alex: agree. priority order: 1) pin rollout to 0% (hold), 2) kick a targeted prefill on failing IG, 3) re-run synth. if the targeted prefill fixes it, we can resume a staggered rollout. rollback only if it repros after warmup ops.

sylvia: i'm on IG patching. will run `kubectl rollout restart` on the three instances showing high latency. command: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefill-agent-eu1 --selector=ig=eu1-thrash`.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by alex. canary traffic set to 0%.

sre-bot: added runbook note: warmup-thrash -> run targeted restart, increase probe interval to 10s for 5m to avoid noisy false positives. I'll patch the synthetic monitor to a 10s window temporarily.

(maya drops a quick screenshot of metrics)

maya: after restart and 60s, re-run curl gives:
```
HTTP/2 200
x-probe-latency-ms: 62
```

maya: p95 back to normal on this host.

sam: good. any evidence of request throttling at the gateway?

sre-bot: gateway logs show ~0% 429s in the window. only KV misses recorded.

alex: ok let's keep rollout paused and run a 5 minute slow ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 10% each 2m with manual check at each step. sylvia, can you coordinate the ramp?

sylvia: starting ramp now. will post after each step.

(2 minutes pass)

sylvia: 1% -> 5% done. synth p95 stable at 58ms, no additional deadman hits.

(another 2 minutes)

sylvia: 10% reached, synths green across zones. I'm leaving the monitor at 10s window for 10m.

alex: consensus — no rollback, cause isolated KV warmup thrash on IG, mitigated by targeted restart. follow-ups: - ops ticket to investigate root cause of warmup thrash (sam) - make the synth monitor less sensitive to transient warmups (sre-bot) - add a prefill warmup during deploys for next rollout (product + eng-releases).

maya: added release note blurb: "Post-deploy: transient prefill SV latency observed in eu1 due to KV warmup. Mitigated via targeted agent restart; rollout resumed with slow ramp. No user-facing impact."

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth-monitor resolved. canary resumed at 10%.

sylvia: :thumbsup: closing the on-call window for this thread.

alex: thanks team. filing postmortem-lite to track mitigation and long-term fix.
